newsitem.title: USA: HNC Software to acquire CompReview.
newsitem.headline: HNC Software to acquire CompReview.

text.p: HNC Software Inc said Tuesday it agreed to acquire CompReview Inc, a privately held insurance information technology services firm, in an all-stock deal valued at about $190 million.

Newport Beach, Calif.-based CompReview develops and markets payment system and medical bill review software products are used primarily by insurance carriers and others who pay or administer workers' compensation and personal injury insurance claims.
The deal, which requires HNC Software shareholder and regulatory approval, is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 1997.
HNC develops advanced decision software solutions based on computational intelligence. HNC's stock gained 3 to 40-7/8 in late morning trading.
